narrative: 房间消失了。红色残留了下来，或者黑色残留了下来，时间长到足以让人感觉像合上了一本书。
接着，另一个房间从同一片场域中诞生。淡入淡出（Fade In / Fade Out）是标点符号，而不是两个故事的混合。
当一场戏是一个章节，当意识陷落，或者你想给观众一个可以喘息的停顿时使用它。当你想要两张应该同时保持存在的画面之间产生温柔的渗透时，这个手法就用错了——那是叠化（Dissolve）。
如果你只是想在一个不断收缩的圆圈里指向一张脸，这个手法也用错了——那是圈入圈出（Iris）。淡出并不自动意味着经过了很长一段时间。
画面变黑后仍在继续的声音，可能意味着一秒钟的失去意识。随画面一同消失的声音，则可能意味着一个终结。
how: 把画面收缩为一片场域（或者从一片场域中升起一幅画面）。选择黑色作为中性的分章方式，或者当那片场域本身应该带有某种情绪时，选择一种颜色（深红、白色）。
协调声音是否在画面清空之后依然存在。不要用雾或烟来伪造一次淡出；画面必须真正消失，而不是被“天气”覆盖。
提示词：fade to or from black around [Subject], chapter punctuation, sleep, death, or the start of a world.
when: 用来开启一部电影、结束一幕，或者标记一次意识的中断。不要在一部当代对话片里的每场戏之间都使用它，除非你想要一种年代感的节奏。
如果两张画面应该重叠，就用叠化。
vs: 叠化让两场戏重叠；淡入淡出则先清空画面。圈入圈出是一种移动的遮罩，在其余部分变黑的同时指向一个细节，而不是整幅画面的淡出。
划像转场（Wipe）让两张画面都保持存在，由一条移动的边界分隔开。暗角（Vignette）是活动画面上的光学衰减，而不是一种转场。
examples_film: 《哭泣与耳语》（Cries and Whispers）用红色场域作为房间与危机之间的情绪化标点。《1917》用一次画面全黑来分隔意识的中断与恢复。
经典好莱坞制片厂电影默认用淡出到黑色来分章。借用这种停顿感，而不是把一种色调当成商标来用。
mistakes: 最常见的误用近亲是叠化（两张画面混合）或用雾来伪装一次淡出。解决办法是走向一片统一的场域，保持片刻，再让下一场戏浮现出来。
不允许重叠，也不允许用“天气”蒙混过关。

faq.q: 电影中的“淡入淡出”是什么？
faq.a: 淡出把画面带向一片统一的黑色或彩色场域，淡入则从中带出画面。剪接点的一侧是一场戏，另一侧是空无，而不是叠加在上面的另一幅画面。

faq.q: 淡入淡出 vs 叠化
faq.a: 叠化让两个镜头重叠，使两者同时可见。淡出/淡入则在两个世界之间插入一片黑色或彩色的场域。叠化是渗透；淡出淡入是标点。

faq.q: 什么时候该用淡入淡出？
faq.a: 用在分章、开场、结尾、睡眠，或意识的丧失上。不要把它用作两张应该共享画面的图像之间的混合手法。

faq.q: 如何为AI图像或视频撰写淡入淡出的提示词？
faq.a: 点明主体和那片场域。示例：Fade to or from black around [Subject], chapter punctuation. 说明声音是否在空白场域上继续，并且不要用烟雾去伪造它。

narrative: The room goes. Red remains, or black does, long enough to feel like a closed book.
Then another room is born from the same field. A fade is punctuation, not a mix of two stories.

Use it when a scene is a chapter, when consciousness drops, or when you want a pause the audience can rest in. It is the wrong tool for a gentle bleed between two images that should both stay present: that is a Dissolve.
It is also the wrong tool if you only want to point at a face inside a shrinking circle: that is an Iris. A fade does not automatically mean a long period has passed.
Sound that continues over black can mean a second of unconsciousness. Sound that dies with the picture can mean an ending.
how: Reduce the picture to a field (or raise a picture out of one). Choose black for neutral chaptering, or a color (deep red, white) when the field itself should feel like a mood.
Coordinate whether sound survives the empty picture. Do not fill the room with fog or smoke to fake a fade; the image must leave, not get weather.
Prompt: fade to or from black around [Subject], chapter punctuation, sleep, death, or the start of a world.
when: Use it to open a film, close an act, or mark a blackout of awareness. Do not use it between every scene in a contemporary dialogue piece unless you want a period cadence.
If two pictures should overlap, dissolve.
vs: A Dissolve overlaps two scenes; a fade empties the frame first. An Iris is a moving mask that points at a detail while the rest goes black, not a full-field fade.
A Wipe keeps both pictures alive, divided by a traveling edge. Vignette is optical falloff on a living image, not a transition.
examples_film: Cries and Whispers uses red fields as emotional punctuation between rooms and crises. 1917 uses a blackout to separate lapse and return of consciousness.
Classical studio films chapter with fades to black as a default. Borrow the pause, not a tint as a trademark.
mistakes: The usual wrong cousin is a Dissolve (two pictures mixed) or fog as a fake fade. ' The fix: go to a uniform field, hold it, then let the next scene emerge.

faq.q: What is Fade In / Fade Out in film?
faq.a: A fade takes the image to or from a uniform black or color field. One side of the join is a scene; the other is absence, not another picture mixed on top.

faq.q: Fade In / Fade Out vs Dissolve
faq.a: A dissolve overlaps two shots so both are visible at once. A fade inserts a field of black or color between worlds. Dissolve bleeds; fade punctuates.

faq.q: When should I use Fade In / Fade Out?
faq.a: Use it for chapter breaks, openings, endings, sleep, or a loss of consciousness. Do not use it as a blend between two images that should share the frame.

faq.q: How do I prompt Fade In / Fade Out for AI image or video?
faq.a: Name the subject and the field. Example: Fade to or from black around [Subject], chapter punctuation. Say whether sound continues over the empty field, and do not fake it with smoke.
